formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (26 : ℕ) x1 → (∀ (x3 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x3) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (x4 = x5 ∨ x4 = x5 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x4 = x5 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x4 = x5 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))) ∧ x3 (Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x4) = Bool.true ∧ x3 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x5) = Bool.true) → (64 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
plain_statement: Plane of order 3. Every circuit of AND and OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires, that computes the incidence function has at least 64 gates.
title: A step toward: Order 3 plane: no circuit of at most 64 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence
